Gianni Infantino, the head of Fifa, faced calls to resign after abandoning a plan to sell private stakes in the World Cup. He was confronted by the BBC in Colombia but refused to answer questions.

The media is actively pursuing accountability, ensuring that the failed privatization attempt remains in the public eye despite the lack of direct answers.

This is a WHO vs HOW error. The question is about WHO (Infantino), but the real issue is HOW Fifa manages its assets and accountability.
